say:2:1310723001:0.text: Everyone, we need to work faster. The festival has started already, and we still need to finish setting up...
say:2:1310723001:0.source_cn: 大家再加把劲儿，祭典都开始了，咱们这里还没布置完……

say:3:1310723002:0.text: We can't afford to make any mistakes at the ball!
say:3:1310723002:0.source_cn: 舞会可千万不能出差错啊！

say:4:1310723003:0.text: Excuse me, has the ball not started yet?
say:4:1310723003:0.source_cn: 请问，舞会还没有开始吗？

say:5:1310723004:0.text: Oh, yes. The masquerade ball won't begin until all the other activities are finished.
say:5:1310723004:0.source_cn: 啊，要等到其他项目都结束，化装舞会才会开始呢。

say:6:1310723005:0.text: I can tell you're anxious for it to begin. Between me and you, I can't wait either.
say:6:1310723005:0.source_cn: 哈哈，看得出来你很心急了。不过偷偷告诉你，其实我也很急呢。

say:7:1310723006:0.text: I really want to know which guest Her Highness will choose to dance with first...
say:7:1310723006:0.source_cn: 真想知道公主殿下会选择哪位客人一起跳第一支舞啊……
